The '''Battle of Xorrn''' was fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attacked the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] repair yard [[Foundry Four/Legends|Foundry Four]] on the planet [[Xorrn/Legends|Xorrn]]. Warned in advance of the upcoming attack by a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in the Empire's midst, the Rebel Alliance was able to gather support from various factions located on the nearby planets, including several [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The specifics of the Battle of Xorrn differ greatly depending on the players' choices in ''Friends Like These.'' The forces aiding the rebels could include the engineers of Foundry Four, the Foundry Four security team, up to three-dozen Mandalorians, a squad of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]], over a dozen [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]], several hundred slave laborers, and salvaged [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]] and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. The choices of commanders on the Rebels' side is also up to the players, including the Cacique of Foundry Four, Chief [[Bellows (clone trooper)|Bellows]], Prince [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]], and Chieftains [[Nam Beroya/Legends|Nam]] and [[Vera Beroya/Legends]]. The Rebels' space capabilities can include automated turbolasers hidden in the asteroid belt, Captain [[Skahvi Renlow]] aboard the ''[[Icarii-7]]'', Prince Molec aboard the ''[[Unbreakable Chain]]'', salvaged droid starfighters, Zygerrian [[HH-87 Starhopper/Legends|HH-87 Starhoppers]], [[YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|YV-865 ''Aurore''-class freighters]], and Xorrn-built fighters flown by Mandalorians.

As Mandalorians are depicted in the main artwork for the battle, this article assumes they were among the recruited.

The battle likely takes place prior to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], as one of the Aftermath of Victory scenarios includes a reference to the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|Tarkin superweapon]].
